    • tupleType

      public final List<@NonNull String> tupleType
      All the TUPLTYPE values, or empty if absent.

      By PAM spec, multiple TUPLTYPE values should be joined by a single space. But this list stores each value, caller can use String.join(" ", list) if needed.

      This list is mutable between readHeader calls.

  • Method Details

    • readHeader

      public void readHeader() throws IOException
      Parse the PAM header from the configured input. On return the buffer's unconsumed bytes (if any) are the beginning of the raster, accessible via CoreImageReader.getBuffer() / CoreImageReader.getBufferPos() / CoreImageReader.getBufferEnd().
      Throws:
      IOException - if the input is not a valid PAM (P7) image, a required header field is missing or duplicated, or an I/O error occurs.
